header_fingerprints.statement: theorem sum_div_sqrt_prefix (a : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) (ha : ∀ t < T, 0 ≤ a t) : (∑ t ∈ range T, a t / Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ range (t + 1), a i)) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ range T, a i)

theorem norm_sq_sum_div_sqrt_prefix {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (g : ℕ → E) (T : ℕ) : (∑ t ∈ range T, ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ range (t + 1), ‖g i‖ ^ 2)) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ range T, ‖g i‖ ^ 2)

theorem source_energy_term_bound {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (g : ℕ → E) (T : ℕ) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 ≤ D) : D / 2 * (∑ t ∈ range T, ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ range (t + 1), ‖g i‖ ^ 2)) ≤ D * Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ range T, ‖g i‖ ^ 2)
